title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: In logistic regression, the decision boundary is a linear equation. Given the coefficients \( \hat{\beta}_1 \) and \( \hat{\beta}_2 \), can you express the decision boundary equation in terms of \( $$x_1$$ \) and \( $$x_2$$ \)?

title: Using the Sigmoid Function
text: The sigmoid function \( \sigma(z) \) is defined as \( \frac{1}{1+e**{-z}} \). If \( \sigma(\log(3))=0.75 \), what does this tell you about the value of \( $$z$$ \) when the threshold is $$0.75$$?

title: Finding the Slope \( $$m$$ \)
text: Given \( \hat{\beta}_1=2 \) and \( \hat{\beta}_2=3 \), what is the slope \( $$m$$ \) of the line \( $$x_2=mx_1+b$$ \)?

title: Finding the Intercept \( $$b$$ \)
text: Using the fact that \( \sigma(\log(3))=0.75 \), what is the intercept \( $$b$$ \) in the equation \( $$x_2=mx_1+b$$ \)?
